_doc: Per-location performance budgets, checked by tests/test_runner.gd (test_location_budgets). 'default' applies to every location; add an entry named after a location id to override single limits. nodes: all nodes in the scene file; props: WorldProp sprites; interactables: Area2D interactions; tiles: painted cells; instantiate_ms: time to instance the scene (generous: CI machines are slow).
